contributions.title: fix(storage): plan non-constant default repairs before DDL
contributions.summary:
Fixes #1318.

A missing column with a non-constant default or STORED expression now refuses repair with REBUILD_SUGGESTION before any DDL when its table contains rows. Empty tables remain repairable, and literal defaults still work on populated tables.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: inspect SQLite's compiled default during the repair plan, reject only the populated-table cases, and pin the schema/data-preservation contract.
contributions.testing:
- 14 focused real-SQLite cases pass: timestamp/date/time/expression/STORED defaults on empty and populated tables, plus literal-default controls.
- The five populated-table regressions fail without the source fix; related schema-drift checks passed (93 passed, 2 skipped).
- Ruff, formatting, commit hooks and KB validation pass.
contributions.notes: The refusal retains the existing suggestion that explains rebuilding index-only state. No partial schema changes are attempted.
contributions.body:

contributions.title: fix(export): report every omitted site source and fail partially
contributions.summary:
Fixes #1325.

Site export now enumerates source files through ExportService, including malformed files that never obtained an index row. It prints each omitted relative path and loader reason, uses proper singular/plural, and exits 3 after a partial export or 1 when nothing could be loaded. Non-regular files are reported without waiting on a FIFO.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: move source enumeration and strict loading into ExportService, keep CLI diagnostics literal, and verify partial/refused outcomes through the real CLI.
contributions.testing:
- Five CLI regressions pass (zero/one valid entries, one/two malformed entries, and a bounded FIFO case); malformed-file cases fail without the fix.
- Related export/renderer checks passed (75 tests).
- CLI layering, requested-effect exit contracts, Ruff/format and commit hooks pass.
contributions.notes: The temporary combined validation also includes #1300's exclusions; each PR is independent. The experimental inventory explicitly classifies the loader-diagnostic test.
contributions.body:

contributions.summary:

Tasks with scalar, list, false, zero or null metadata now load as tasks. The original metadata node is preserved, QA reports a metadata warning, and an unrelated title edit succeeds with a warning while retaining that node's bytes.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: retain malformed metadata outside the model's mapping bag, let validation judge it, and test actual read/QA/write behavior.
contributions.testing:
- Five real-file/CLI shape cases pass; all five fail on the base.
- Task metadata cases and related write contracts pass in the combined integration run.
- Ruff, formatting, commit hooks and KB validation pass.
contributions.notes: Coordination with #1311: its metadata-whole refusal case should become a lenient-load/warning case when this lands. Other loader conversions remain outside this change.

contributions.title: fix(kb): honor configured exclusions across entry file walks
contributions.summary:
Fixes #1300.

kb.yaml exclude patterns now govern Markdown and collection-file enumeration, lookup, indexing, QA/validation and export walks. Service helpers share that rule with CLI callers. Exclusions are read independently of type definitions so malformed schemas remain inspectable by health checks.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: implement exclusions in the shared repository walk, route remaining CLI walks through services, document pattern behavior, and exercise consumers with real files.
contributions.testing:
- 17 focused cases cover file/entry/count/index/QA/export/schema consumers, collection/nested patterns, invalid lists and malformed type schemas.
- Exclusion/health/layering compatibility run: 80 passed.
- Ruff/format, commit hooks and KB validation pass.
contributions.notes: If exclusions cannot be parsed, enumeration keeps files available and logs the reason; schema validation reports the malformed configuration. Explicit schema-validation file arguments still permit inspecting a named excluded file.

contributions.summary:
Fixes #1274.

A shared vocabulary helper reports undeclared relations without rejecting or changing the requested link. Single and bulk link writes, CLI link/create, MCP and QA expose the warning. Declared relations and aliases remain quiet; backlinks retain their documented inverse behavior.

contributions.testing:

- Related link contracts: 95 passed, 1 skipped in the earlier focused run; integration rerun covers existing JSON and bidirectional output contracts.
- Rich warnings stay on stderr; Ruff/format and commit hooks pass.
contributions.notes: Relations remain case-sensitive as the existing vocabulary is. No per-KB relationship schema or backlink shape change is introduced.

contributions.title: feat(csv): add opt-in spreadsheet text escaping
contributions.summary:
Refs #851 (feature proposal; retain the issue for exhaustive emitter-level acceptance).

Add --format csv-safe, format=csv-safe on entries export, and csv_safe=true for negotiated REST CSV. One serializer escapes dangerous leading characters in every serialized cell, including headers and signed numbers. Raw csv remains the default and its existing serialization path is unchanged.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: implement the groom's separate-format option in the shared registry, update all 42 CLI help declarations, document the prefix/limits, and test table shapes plus representative real CLI/REST routes.
contributions.testing:
- 115 focused cases pass in the combined run: 64 table-shape/leading-character cases, real CLI and REST checks, raw negotiation control, header/number behavior, and a 42-command declaration inventory plus its source scan.
- Related CSV/format checks passed earlier; the final integration run covers Accept-quality behavior and the security inventory.
- Ruff/format and commit hooks pass.
contributions.notes: The apostrophe prefix follows the documented text-import convention, including fullwidth variants; no universal spreadsheet/save-reopen guarantee is claimed. Remaining #851 acceptance: executable fixtures for every CLI/REST emitter rather than representative runtime routes. No MCP or import change.

contributions.title: test(storage): reject unclassified non-raising database handlers
contributions.summary:
Refs #1316 (explicit-handler portion; keep the issue open).

The classifier guard now catches explicit database handlers that return error dictionaries, echo and return, call an opaque helper, or set suggestion through setattr. Existing log/fallback handlers require individually recorded NOT_THE_CLASSIFIERS_JOB reasons rather than passing because they have no raise.
contributions.claim: This PR is the claim: strengthen explicit sqlite/SQLAlchemy/MigrationError handler checks, inspect each newly exposed fallback, and add scratch tricks for the missed forms.
contributions.testing:
- Full index-schema-drift file: 83 passed, 2 skipped.
- Four added scratch forms are rejected; current source handlers pass with eight inspected fallback explanations.
- Guard checks also pass in the combined integration run; Ruff/format and commit hooks pass.
contributions.notes: Remaining #1316 scope: broad except Exception handlers that convert to ValidationError, HTTPException or an arbitrary factory result. This PR does not claim to detect those. Changelog: none
